issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires that ExcellenceLand.rides is a private attribute (Task 3: "The attribute `rides` is of type `List<Ride>` and private"). In the solution implementation, the rides attribute is declared public (public List<Ride> rides;). This contradicts the specified visibility and may confuse students about the expected field visibility and what their constructors/getters should manage. It can also cause automated tests that assert private visibility to fail.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the visibility of the rides attribute in the solution (and template) to private (private List<Ride> rides;) and keep the public getter getRides(). This brings the implementation in line with the problem statement requirement that rides is private while preserving the intended API.
